business_focus_note: KEPT (borderline): ramming mass, the refractory lining of induction furnaces, sold to secondary steel makers (mostly TMT for construction). An industrial consumable, not equipment; NSE classes it Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Electrodes & Refractories.

FIT (capex, not infrastructure): glass-lined reactors and process equipment (mixing, filtration, drying) for chemical and pharmaceutical plants; ~50% domestic share. Demand follows the chemical/pharma capex cycle rather than public infrastructure.

FIT: precision electrical components. Thermostatic bimetals (~40% of revenue; ~65% of that goes into switchgear and circuit breakers), shunt resistors (~40%: smart meters, EV battery management, energy storage) and electrical contacts (~19%). Mostly power distribution / switchgear supply chain; the EV part is a minority. Screener's 'Iron & Steel Products' label understates this.
FIT: cranes, construction and material-handling equipment ~92% of FY25 revenue; agri equipment (incl. tractors) ~8%.
